Title: Home Page — LLM Reviews & Quick Reference
Summary: Authoritative reference for the index.html home page: hero, comparison table, offline/cloud review cards, and tips section.
Content:
## Overview

The home page (`index.html`) is the primary landing page for the Cyréna LLM review site. It contains a hero, a quick-reference comparison table, offline model reviews, cloud model reviews, and general tips.

## HTML Structure

- `<header class="site-header">` — shared sticky header (see `cyr-001`).
- `<section class="hero">` — centered headline "LLM Reviews for Developers", subtitle, and two CTA buttons (View Quick Reference, Read Reviews).
- `<section id="quick-reference" class="quick-reference">` — comparison table with 13 rows covering offline and cloud models.
- `<section id="offline" class="reviews">` — 6 review cards for offline Ollama models.
- `<section id="cloud" class="reviews-cloud">` — 7 review cards for cloud models.
- `<section id="tips" class="tips">` — 4 tip cards with numbered advice.
- `<footer class="site-footer">` — shared footer (see `cyr-001`).

## Key Components

### Hero
- `.hero-actions` contains `.btn-primary` and `.btn-secondary`.
- Background: gradient from white to surface.

### Comparison Table
- `.table-wrapper` provides `overflow-x: auto` and border/shadow.
- `.comparison-table` has 6 columns: Category, Model, Size, Best-use case(s), Key Strengths / Weaknesses, Notes.
- Minimum width: `900px` for horizontal scroll on small screens.
- Alternating hover state on rows.

### Review Cards
- `.review-grid` uses responsive grid: 1 col → 2 col (`640px`) → 3 col (`1024px`).
- `.review-featured` adds a left accent border and is used for `gpt-5` and `kimi-k2.6`.
- `.badge` highlights "Outstanding" and "Favourite" models.

### Tips
- `.tips-grid` uses responsive grid: 1 col → 2 col (`640px`) → 4 col (`1024px`).
- `.tip-number` is an absolutely positioned accent circle at the top-left of each card.

## Accessibility
- All sections use `aria-labelledby` pointing to their heading.
- Table uses proper `scope="col"` on headers.
- Skip link targets `#main-content`.

## Asset References
- `css/styles.css`
- `js/main.js`
- Internal anchor links: `#quick-reference`, `#offline`, `#cloud`, `#tips`
- Page link: `about.html`
